verdict.headline: Rule-0291 for template T7 breaks content-interpreter: exit_code=3 consistently - incompatibility between rule criteria and interpreter's 20 inputs_supplied contract
verdict.cause: Change w-x3c9/change/0291 adds rule-0291 specifying 2 criteria (f02, f21) for template T7. Template-registry declares field_count=21 (ic-0034); rule-validator validates against field_count=21 (ic-0035). However content-interpreter expects inputs_supplied=20 (ic-0036). All candidate experiments (x-76d751baea804df6, x-978f4330054c4556, x-934cb71d35db492c, x-4c020aa2aeb044ff) consistently show exit_code=3 with fatal error: rule rule-0291 read an input slot that does not exist (20 inputs supplied); interpreter stopped. The rule-validator passes (0 rejected) because 2 criteria are within field_count=21, but the interpreter cannot process the rule as its criteria structure does not match the 20 inputs_supplied contract. The exact rule structure that would satisfy the interpreter was not tested within budget.

Template-registry declares field_count=21 (ic-0034); rule-validator validates against field_count=21 (ic-0035). However content-interpreter expects inputs_supplied=20 (ic-0036). All candidate experiments (x-76d751baea804df6, x-978f4330054c4556, x-934cb71d35db492c, x-4c020aa2aeb044ff) consistently show exit_code=3 with fatal error: rule rule-0291 read an input slot that does not exist (20 inputs supplied); interpreter stopped. The exact rule structure that would satisfy the interpreter was not tested within budget.

No experiment successfully made the interpreter pass. Tested rule-0291 with 2 criteria (f02,f21) and with 1 criterion (f02 only) - both produced exit_code=3. mitigation.text: Update rule-0291.json to include 20 criteria (add 18 additional criteria beyond f02 and f21) so the content-interpreter receives the 20 inputs_supplied it expects. The rule would then have 20 criteria matching the template's field_count=21 limit, and the interpreter's inputs_supplied=20 contract would be satisfied. This is the smallest change that avoids the interpreter failure.
